rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: MEIzoele
Exhibition name: Glowing Peace
rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 1998). Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 1998).
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) as 'Glowing Peace'.
rows.Bloom: Orange and yellow, red edges. None to mild, tea fragrance. 26 to 45 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 35" to 47" (90 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 3' (60 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
